receipt.public_excerpt: The DDTL 4.0 Facility received ratings of A3 by Moody’s and A (low) by DBRS, respectively, representing the first investment-grade rated financing secured by HPC infrastructure and an associated customer contract.

evidence_items.explanation: A large neocloud loan was formally secured by hardware and a customer contract and rated investment grade. This cuts against a literal 'uncollateralized' reading for this deal. It does not settle the economic reading, and it is one deal among many.

evidence_items.explanation: Private credit was lending to data center builds with no signed lease, based on a demand thesis. This fits part of his picture. The same piece also says lenders require equity, power certainty and lease-up covenants.
